notes: betaApkUrl now points at the CI-published android-debug-latest GitHub Release (always the newest debug build, rebuilt on demand) instead of the once-committed app/tiga-ai-beta.apk — so the in-app 'update' button always gets the current APK. apkReady/apkUrl remains the future production-signed release (see MOBILE_BUILD.md) — flip apkReady once app/tiga-ai.apk exists. Debug and production builds use different signing keys, so a device that installs the beta build will need one uninstall+reinstall the day the signed production build replaces it — expected, not a bug.
